findings.note: Nov 13 preview: Wild top-line center Joel Eriksson Ek left Thursday's win at Toronto after a high hit from Jake McCabe and did not return, though Hynes does not expect a long-term injury; the Wild come in on a 10-game point streak and Boston is trying to bounce back from a season-worst loss.

Game page lists Eriksson Ek as day-to-day, Brock Faber (D) on IR and Filip Gustavsson on long-term IR for Minnesota, with Wallstedt at 13-2-3, .925; Boston is missing only James Hagens and is 8-2-0 at home; the Wild moneyline is shown at about -122 to -130.

Covers lists mixed trends: the Wild are 7-0 in their last 7 road games, but the Bruins are 7-1 in their last 8 after a loss by 3+ goals; the Wild moneyline consensus is about -117, with -115 the best price listed.
